name: Disneyland Carnation Cafe Sourdough Patty Melt (Hold Sautéed Onions Mod)
whyItWorks: Charbroiled Angus patty with melted Swiss and aged parmesan cheese on grilled fermented sourdough bread. Holding sautéed onions eliminates gas-producing allium fructans.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Patty Melt on sourdough with Swiss cheese; request 'no sautéed onions and light butter on the bread'.
watchOuts: Request no sautéed onions to prevent fructan gas
